d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Austria vs Jordan in Group J of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California. After Romano Schmid fired Austria ahead in the 20th minute, Ali Olwan netted Jordan's first-ever World Cup goal early in the second half to level before Yazan Al-Arab turned into his own net and substitute Marko Arnautović converted a late stoppage-time penalty to seal a 3-1 win for Austria.
